title: Inequality and Skin in the Game
coreMove: Judge inequality by whether the winners stayed exposed to the risks that produced their rewards.
sourcePressure: Taleb separates inequality earned under shared downside from inequality protected by privilege and loss transfer.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Turning the chapter into generic inequality is bad or meritocracy is good.

sourceAnchors.name: Inequality and Skin in the Game
sourceAnchors.detail: The source sidecar supports the distinction between legitimate hierarchy under exposure and illegitimate hierarchy protected from loss.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The visible question is not who has more, but whether the people at the top could fall from the risks they ask others to bear.
